title: Count Unique Binary Search Trees
description: Given an integer `n`, return the number of structurally unique BST's (binary search trees) which has exactly `n` nodes of unique values from 1 to `n` (Catalan Number).
hints: Let dp[i] be number of unique BSTs with i nodes.
Pick each node j (1 <= j <= i) as root.
Then left subtree has j - 1 nodes and right has i - j nodes: `dp[i] += dp[j-1] * dp[i-j]`.
